tasks.label: Verify Deployed OSM Endpoints
args: const base='https://city-digital-twin-data.yug-nirmanyug-nirman.workers.dev'; const origin='https://ai-future-city-simulator.yug-nirmanyug-nirman.workers.dev'; for (const route of ['/api/status','/api/osm/features?lat=19.076&lon=72.8777','/api/osm/roads?lat=19.076&lon=72.8777']) { const response=await fetch(base+route,{headers:{Origin:origin}}); const text=await response.text(); let result; try { const data=JSON.parse(text); result={...data,elements:Array.isArray(data.elements)?data.elements.length:undefined}; } catch { result=text.slice(0,300); } console.log(route,response.status,JSON.stringify(result)); }

tasks.label: Verify Worker OSM Responses
args: const base="https://city-digital-twin-data.yug-nirmanyug-nirman.workers.dev"; const origin="https://ai-future-city-simulator.yug-nirmanyug-nirman.workers.dev"; for (const type of ["status","features","roads"]) { const url=new URL(type==="status"?"/api/status":"/api/osm/"+type,base); if(type!=="status"){url.searchParams.set("lat","19.076");url.searchParams.set("lon","72.8777");} const response=await fetch(url,{headers:{Origin:origin}}); const data=await response.json(); console.log(type,response.status,JSON.stringify({...data,elements:Array.isArray(data.elements)?data.elements.length:undefined})); }
